newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Tallinn Pharma sees 30 mln kroon '99 net.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Tallinn Pharma sees 30 mln kroon '99 net.

text.p: Estonian drug producer Tallinn Pharmaceutical forecast on Thursday that it would make a 1996 net profit of 29.5 million kroons and earn a profit in 1997 of 38.5 million kroons.
The company, which earned 16.4 million kroons during 1995, earlier this year made an issue of shares to international investors and is quoted on the Tallinn stock exchange.
"Our forecast is based on the agreements we have signed or which are in the final stage," Tallinn Pharmaceutical chairman Margus Linnamae said in a statement.
He said that 1997 sales would reach 200 million kroons.
The company also gave figures for its profit after 11 months of 1996, which was 26 million kroons on sales of 130 million kroons. Turnover in 1995 was 107.6 million kroons.
